Every day, growth and discovery take shape here—when students find their voice, when learning leads to purpose, and when our community comes together to create rich opportunities. Ventura College is a place where ambitions meet support, and where potential is nurtured into achievement.

Our mission is simple: to empower students to share the future—for themselves, their families, and for the world around them. Together, we are advancing a Ventura College that reflects the very best of who we are—resilient, inclusive, and together by purpose.
Thank you for being part of this extraordinary community of learners and leaders. The journey ahead is full of promise—and it begins right here, with you.

Ventura College is proud to be a chapter of SALUTE Veterans National Honor Society.

excerpts.line: Contact elizabeth_vasquez9@vcccd.edu erubalcava@vcccd.edu in the Veteran Resource Center.
window: Charlie Tier GPA: grade point average between 3.25 - 3.49
Delta Tier GPA: grade point average between 3.00 - 3.24
Contact elizabeth_vasquez9@vcccd.edu erubalcava@vcccd.edu in the Veteran Resource Center.
Ventura College will cover the cost of the $35 application fee.
Your Unofficial Transcript and DD214 will be requested during the application process.
Upon document verification, you will be added to the Ventura College Chapter, and your name will be sent to SALUTE National as an inductee!
Election of our students to the Veterans National Honor Society of SALUTE is our commitment bestowed upon you for your excellent academic record and service to our country.
*Each semester upon award, photos of all recipients will be shown below with their majors, GPAS, Honor Society Tier levels, and military branches.*

excerpts.line: VA Women Veterans Call Center - Call or text 1-855-829-6636 (Mon-Fri 8am-10pm & Sat 8am-5pm ET)
window: VA Mental Health Services Guide - This guide will help you sign up and access mental health services.
VA's Self-Help Apps – Downloadable apps that provide tools to help deal with common reactions like, stress, sadness, and anxiety.
VA Caregiver Support Program - Call the support line at 1-855-260-3274 (Mon-Fri 8am-10pm & Sat 8am-5pm ET)
VA Women Veterans Call Center - Call or text 1-855-829-6636 (Mon-Fri 8am-10pm & Sat 8am-5pm ET)

Elizabeth Dole Foundation Hidden Heroes - Raises awareness of the issues military & veteran caregivers confront every day, and to inspire businesses, communities, and government leaders to take action in supporting military and veteran caregivers.
Patients Like Me – a community where you can learn from/talk with others who served in Iraq and Afghanistan

Horses Helping Heroes! - A ‘hands on’ organization that helps service men and women heal, regain control, and return to their lives. 5-day Healing Intensives are a unique experience for veterans, first responders, spouses or caregivers – free of charge. Sign up on the 2025 waitlist dates.
*Sanctuary and Healing Center are located in Ohio.

Required for all active-duty, and veterans using benefits (including VR&E); not Chapter 35. These must be sent electronically from the branch of service to the campus.

The Board of Governors of the California Community College system offers a fee waiver program for low-income residents of California that are attending a community college. The CCPG will waive all per-unit enrollment fees ($46 per unit) for an eligible student.
What is the Jordana Ybarra-Telias Grant?
The Jordana Ybarra-Telias Emergency Grant is a grant used to support students facing temporary financial hardship because of an emergency or crisis.
